"""Read frozen style receipts and complete logs; never execute a style gate."""
from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/workspace/e02-B-current-coordination')
RAW = ROOT / '.polisyos/e02-B-current/raw/review'
SHA = '4e7a4924e6466e1b4eaa39b504435a1243aeb90b'
TREE = '9beb525a5dfd68a610ceb719d4f5b802c3da0e2c'
EXPECTED_ARTIFACTS = {
    'final-all-changed-format-profile.json': 'd3a9e0d3be152f7ae7b196e0fc88cf097c351edf99e402aa6b8c8bece443f08b',
    'final-all-changed-format.json': '9c4bec9800d3eafa69d9f8d34fcdf1b2b2fa7ab9887301799f71e373ee7e92cc',
    'final-all-changed-format.txt': '28dbc4df56e416965fbf8f5cd84ff65376ee90c18b1ac5298bd3af6cf464643b',
    'final-all-changed-ruff-profile.json': 'bae7daffe69103f75044d99f63a017da852cff87a26a92379c03b28eefcb11f5',
    'final-all-changed-ruff.json': '9e53b8bf08f20e873a5aa415ff5e7ee94cd4d4d00f6894ea3d7fa7ba6b6ababf',
    'final-all-changed-ruff.txt': '118e68e8f6aca2e9c3f5e6c9f567bff2480d73a53878df1091744754ef97badc',
}


def git(*args: str) -> bytes:
    return subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def category(path: str) -> str:
    normalized = path.removeprefix('policy-engine/')
    if normalized.startswith('docs/'):
        return 'docs_witnesses'
    if normalized.startswith('src/'):
        return 'production'
    if normalized.startswith('tests/'):
        return 'tests'
    return 'other'


def counted(items) -> dict:
    return dict(sorted(collections.Counter(items).items()))


def source_ref(path: str) -> dict:
    data = git('show', f'{SHA}:{path}')
    return {
        'path': path, 'sha': SHA,
        'git_blob': git('rev-parse', f'{SHA}:{path}').decode().strip(),
        'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'bytes': len(data),
    }


assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == SHA
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip() == TREE
before = git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=normal').decode()
assert before == ''
artifact_refs = []
for name, digest in EXPECTED_ARTIFACTS.items():
    data = (RAW / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    artifact_refs.append({'path': str(RAW / name), 'sha256': digest, 'bytes': len(data)})
profiles = {kind: json.loads((RAW / f'final-all-changed-{kind}-profile.json').read_text()) for kind in ('ruff', 'format')}
metadata = {kind: json.loads((RAW / f'final-all-changed-{kind}.json').read_text()) for kind in ('ruff', 'format')}
inputs = profiles['ruff']['inputs']
paths = inputs['paths']
assert profiles['format']['inputs'] == inputs
assert len(paths) == inputs['count'] == len(set(paths))
base = inputs['literal_comparison_base']
fresh = inputs['fresh_published_base_projection_only']
for ref, expected in ((base, paths), (fresh['base'], fresh['paths'])):
    actual = [p for p in git('diff', '--name-only', f'{ref}...{SHA}').decode().splitlines() if p.startswith('policy-engine/') and p.endswith('.py')]
    assert actual == expected, ref
assert len(fresh['paths']) == fresh['count']
assert all(Path(p).suffix == '.py' for p in paths)
selected_bytes_match = 0
for path in paths:
    assert git('show', f'{SHA}:{path}') == (ROOT / path).read_bytes(), path
    selected_bytes_match += 1
for kind in ('ruff', 'format'):
    profile, result = profiles[kind], metadata[kind]
    assert (profile['sha'], profile['tree']) == (SHA, TREE)
    assert (result['head'], result['head_after'], result['tree']) == (SHA, SHA, TREE)
    assert result['command'] == profile['argv']
    assert result['cwd'] == profile['cwd'] == str(ROOT / 'policy-engine')
    prefix = [profile['argv'][0], '-m', 'ruff', 'check', '--no-cache'] if kind == 'ruff' else [profile['argv'][0], '-m', 'ruff', 'format', '--check']
    assert profile['argv'] == prefix + [p.removeprefix('policy-engine/') for p in paths]
    assert result['exit_code'] == 1
    output = Path(result['output_path']).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(output).hexdigest() == result['output_sha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(profile['launcher_path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == profile['launcher_sha256']
text = (RAW / 'final-all-changed-ruff.txt').read_text()
pattern = r'^([A-Z]+\d{3}) (?:\[\*\] )?([^\n]*)\n(?:(?!^[A-Z]+\d{3} ).*\n)*?\s+--> ([^\n]+?):(\d+):(\d+)\n'
rows = re.findall(pattern, text, re.MULTILINE)
terminal = re.findall(r'^Found (\d+) errors\.$', text, re.MULTILINE)
assert terminal == [str(len(rows))] == ['4271']
headers = re.findall(r'^[A-Z]+\d{3} (?:\[\*\] )?[^\n]*$', text, re.MULTILINE)
assert len(headers) == len(rows)
assert all('policy-engine/' + row[2] in paths for row in rows)
by_path = collections.Counter(row[2] for row in rows)
format_text = (RAW / 'final-all-changed-format.txt').read_text()
reformatted = re.findall(r'^Would reformat: (.+)$', format_text, re.MULTILINE)
format_terminal = re.findall(r'^(\d+) files would be reformatted, (\d+) files already formatted$', format_text, re.MULTILINE)
assert format_terminal == [('99', '114')]
assert len(reformatted) == len(set(reformatted)) == 99
assert 99 + 114 == len(paths)
assert all('policy-engine/' + p in paths for p in reformatted)
red_docs = sorted(p for p in set(by_path) | set(reformatted) if category(p) == 'docs_witnesses')
assert all(p.startswith('docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/implementation-handoffs/B/') for p in red_docs)
diagnostic_path_counts = []
for path, count in sorted(by_path.items()):
    diagnostic_path_counts.append({**source_ref('policy-engine/' + path), 'category': category(path), 'diagnostics': count})
format_non_docs = [source_ref('policy-engine/' + path) for path in reformatted if category(path) != 'docs_witnesses']
non_docs = [{'code': code, 'message': message, 'path': path, 'line': int(line), 'column': int(column)} for code, message, path, line, column in rows if category(path) != 'docs_witnesses']
contract_paths = [
    'AGENTS.md', 'policy-engine/CONTRIBUTING.md',
    'policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/execution-prompts/HANDOFF.md',
    'policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/closure-decisions/verification-and-closeout.md',
    'policy-engine/docs/reference/policy-design-case-failure-patterns.md',
    'policy-engine/docs/reference/repository-hygiene.md',
    'policy-engine/docs/reference/quality-gates.md',
    'policy-engine/tools/devx/workspace/_repo_hygiene.py',
    'policy-engine/tools/devx/workspace/lint_fast.py',
    'policy-engine/ruff.toml', 'policy-engine/architecture/tooling/ruff/generated.toml',
]
report = {
    'schema': 'policyos.e02.final_style_readonly_audit.v1',
    'observed_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'reviewer': '/root/cas_probe', 'source_sha': SHA, 'source_tree': TREE,
    'root_status_before': before, 'audit_mode': 'read_only_metadata_and_log_parse_no_style_or_runtime_replay',
    'audit_outcome': 'PASS', 'gate_outcomes': {'ruff': 'FAIL', 'format': 'FAIL'},
    'artifact_refs': artifact_refs,
    'commands': {kind: {'complete_argv_ref': str(RAW / f'final-all-changed-{kind}.json'), 'cwd': metadata[kind]['cwd'], 'prefix': metadata[kind]['command'][:5], 'operand_count': len(paths), 'wall_s': metadata[kind]['wall_s'], 'process_rusage_maxrss_kib': metadata[kind]['process_rusage_maxrss_kib'], 'exit_code': metadata[kind]['exit_code']} for kind in ('ruff', 'format')},
    'input_census': {
        'literal_base': base, 'count': len(paths), 'file_type_counts': {'.py': len(paths)},
        'category_counts': counted(category(p) for p in paths),
        'all_selected_worktree_bytes_match_frozen_git': selected_bytes_match,
        'full_input_list_ref': str(RAW / 'final-all-changed-ruff-profile.json') + '#inputs.paths',
        'fresh_projection_only': {'base': fresh['base'], 'count': fresh['count'], 'category_counts': counted(category(p) for p in fresh['paths']), 'not_a_gate_substitute': True},
        'literal_only_paths': sorted(set(paths) - set(fresh['paths'])),
    },
    'ruff': {
        'parsed_diagnostics': len(rows), 'terminal_diagnostics': int(terminal[0]),
        'category_diagnostic_counts': counted(category(row[2]) for row in rows),
        'diagnostic_file_count': len(by_path), 'category_file_counts': counted(category(p) for p in by_path),
        'code_counts': counted(row[0] for row in rows),
        'non_docs_diagnostics': non_docs, 'diagnostics_by_path': diagnostic_path_counts,
        'docs_subdirectory_counts': counted('/'.join(row[2].split('/')[:6]) for row in rows if category(row[2]) == 'docs_witnesses'),
    },
    'format': {'would_reformat': len(reformatted), 'already_formatted': 114, 'category_counts': counted(category(p) for p in reformatted), 'non_docs_paths': format_non_docs, 'docs_paths_are_exact_b_handoff_witnesses': True},
    'contract_refs': [source_ref(p) for p in contract_paths],
    'profile_boundary': {
        'e02_closeout_literal_all_changed_python_required': 'verification-and-closeout.md lines51-52,60',
        'canonical_lint_fast_scope': 'specific authored operands at _repo_hygiene.py lines12-34, actual lint_fast.py lines41-51 omit docs Python; this distinct profile does not replace the e02 literal gate',
        'docs_python_exemption': 'none_established; repository-hygiene.md lines18-25,54-59 includes authored docs and repo-wide authored Python',
    },
    'p41': {
        'inherited_or_disjoint_red': 'NOT_ESTABLISHED',
        'exact_base_gate_replay': 'UNRUN_by_this_read_only_audit',
        'literal_gate_inputs_changed_from_literal_base': len(paths),
        'literal_gate_inputs_changed_from_fresh_entry_base': len(set(paths) & set(fresh['paths'])),
        'reason': 'Complete input denominator intersects B changes; preserved earlier driver bytes and old source summaries do not establish inherited/disjoint red.',
    },
    'limitations': [
        'No style gate, test collection, product runtime or baseline replay executed by this auditor.',
        'Witness driver classification names exact tracked B handoff paths; it neither exempts them nor promotes historical evidence to candidate PASS.',
        'Full 2.8MB Ruff stdout remains ignored raw path@SHA; audit parsed every header/location and reconciled the terminal count. Remote evidence availability requires root Git transfer or qualified receiver replay.',
        'Frozen original historical witness bytes must be preserved under immutable source/artifact refs. Any forward cleanup requires owners to preserve prior hashes/receipts and review semantic identity; no original output or checksum was rewritten.',
        'Production source fixes belong EXE owner for checkpoint.py/executor.py; test style fixes belong EXE test owner; historical witness hygiene/custody routing belongs each evidence owner under root/G coordination.',
    ],
}
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == SHA
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').decode().strip() == TREE
assert git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=normal').decode() == before
report['root_head_after'] = SHA
report['root_tree_after'] = TREE
report['root_status_after'] = before
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
